blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: Shows whether CostPilot blocked the request before it reached an AI model.

costPilotResponse.title: CostPilot Response
costPilotResponse.description: The governed response from CostPilot that the agent should use when responding to the user.

modelTier.title: Model Tier
modelTier.description: The model tier CostPilot selected for the request, such as Scout, Analyst, Advisor, or Strategist.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: The routing or governance outcome recorded by CostPilot.

riskLevel.title: Risk Level
riskLevel.description: The risk level CostPilot assigned to the request.
